 Live .  2,430 viewing 2430 viewing Live page Updated 1 minute ago Britain's Smith defends title in absorbing split-decision win v Puello - reaction
 Summary
 Use 'Listen live' icon at top of page for BBC Radio 5 Live commentary from 21:00 BST
 Sheffield's Dalton Smith retains WBC light-welterweight title in absorbing split-decision win over Alberto Puello
 Bellew column - how world champion Smith can become a mainstream star 
 Smith v Puello world title fight predictions 
 Close form Send us your boxing views
 Get involved Live Reporting
 Chris McKenna
 Adam Azim? published at 22:37 BST 22:37 BST 
 Smith beats Puello by split decision 
 It was interesting that in the ring there after the fight there was no mention of British rival Adam Azim.
 Azim has been out of the ring since May when he beat Steve Claggett in what has been his only fight since 2026.
 Dalton Smith and Azim appeared to be on a collision course for a domestic showdown but talk of that has gone quiet due to the latter's inactivity.
 Saying that the DAZN team have been debating it and former WBC cruiserweight champion Tony Bellew wants to see Azim win the vacant IBF title first before they face each other in a unification.

 'Unbelievable' published at 22:33 BST 22:33 BST 
 Smith beats Puello by split decision 
 Some more words from Dalton Smith to DAZN... 
 On how mentally challenging the fight was: “Look did you ever think I was going to vacate this belt to go a different route? Not a chance. I know how hard I have worked for this, and I wanted to bring it back home for every single person here.”
 On the atmosphere: “Unbelievable. When I did my ring walk, I had that dream so many times and it gives me goose-pimples now. Honestly from the bottle of my heart, I can’t thank everybody enough for coming out tonight."
 On who’s next: “Number one goal in my life was to become world champion and make history, the second was to sell out Hillsborough stadium. I had that carrot dangled out in front of me for so long, I had to block out the noise, stay professional, it was hard, and keep my eyes on the ball tonight."
 Image source, Getty Images

 'I’m proving why I’m number one now' published at 22:31 BST 22:31 BST 
 Smith beats Puello by split decision 
 WBC champion Dalton Smith speaking to DAZN after retaining his title: “We knew what we were coming in for, he’s a two-time world
champion [and] look at the names he’s beat. We knew it wasn’t going to be a show, he
was going to be an awkward opponent, but a champion has to do what he has to do.
These are the best in the world and I’m proving why I’m number one now.”
 On what won him the fight: “I got his rhythm early on. I
think he respected my power, but look, he’s experienced. He’s a lot more experienced
than me, and that’s what I’m gaining now. I switched off a little bit in the
early rounds, but I did what a true champion did and win the last couple, so I’m
very proud.”

 Who is next? published at 22:26 BST 22:26 BST 
 Smith beats Puello by split decision 
 Well... that is Subriel Matias and Alberto Puello behind Dalton Smith now.
 There was a lot of talk about WBO light-welterweight champion Shakur Stevenson in the ring afterwards.
 There are some big fights in the 10st division among the other champions.

 Hillsborough next? published at 22:22 BST 22:22 BST 
 Smith beats Puello by split decision 
 Image source, Getty Dalton Smith is a diehard Sheffield Wednesday fan when it comes to football.
 It has long been a dream of his to fight at their home stadium - Hillsborough.
 Smith's promoter Eddie Hearn has again called for a fight there and wants to keep talks going.

 Smith retains title published at 22:20 BST 22:20 BST 
 Smith beats Puello by split decision 
 Both men come out of that fight with huge credit.
 Dalton Smith took on the mandatory challenger who was a two-time champion with huge experience and he had to dig very deep to get over the line.
 The Sheffield fighter has now beaten two of the top fighters at light-welterweight and retains the WBC title.
 Alberto Puello came to enemy territory and put in a brilliant performance. He can certainly come again.
 It was so close neither man could have really argued whichever way the decision went.
 That is what top-level boxing is all about.

 Round twelve published at 22:12 BST 22:12 BST 
 Smith v Puello 
 Both men give it their all in that last round.
 Smith counters brilliantly with a left hook after catching one of Puello's shots on the gloves.
 Puello responds with another cracking shot into the midriff of Smith.
 Then the Sheffield boxer rushes in, gets through with a right before the pair clinch. 
 Smith - bloodied under his right eye - lands with a right to the body but Puello fires back with a left hand.
 The defending champion wheels away raising his hands in victory and jumps up on the ropes before his dad lifts him up.
 We go to the scorecards... they could be interesting reading!

 Post published at 22:09 BST 22:09 BST 
 Smith v Puello 
 BBC Radio 5 Live 
 Tony Bellew with a message for Dalton Smith: "He has to go, and go again. Puello needs time and space to get the shots off. Puello is doing a very good job of countering Dalton Smith, but Smith has to counter the counter. He has to make Puello miss.

 Round eleven published at 22:07 BST 22:07 BST 
 Smith v Puello 
 Smith is cut above the right eye as the tenth round starts at a frantic pace.
 The champion lands with a great right but Puello responds with a fizzing combination.
 Puello gets through with a left hand but Smith responds with a one-two. 
 The challenger gets through with a left uppercut to the body as Smith tries to rush in. His reach is a huge advantage. 
 One more round to go. Can we not have another 12? Fantastic.

 'Now they look tired!' published at 22:06 BST 22:06 BST 
 Smith v Puello 
 Steve Bunce 
Boxing expert on BBC Radio 5 Live 
 That was a really hard round for the pair of them. They had to dig deep there, they both got caught with big shots. They both suddenly looked like they have been in a 10 round fight. In round six or seven they looked fresh. Now they look tired!
 24 2 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Round ten published at 22:03 BST 22:03 BST 
 Smith v Puello 
 Smith lands with a lovely right early in the tenth but again Puello responds.
 This time it is a right hook and a lovely left from the southpaw.
 Smith rushes in and tries to unload on Puello on the ropes but the slippery challenger pivots away smartly.
 The pair exhange before the bell. This is so close. Good luck to the judges...
